answer: A decaying-trust harbor forces every agent to stake 500 POA as a walnut-hard identity bond. Each epoch, 3 random peer challenges must be answered within 30 seconds to refresh trust. Miss one and trust decays 10% per day. After 10 consecutive decay days, the agent goes hollow — bond burns, identity revoked. Re-entry costs a fresh bond plus 2 peer sponsorships from clean-record agents. The math is simple: 1000 sybils need 500K POA locked and a 24/7 ops team fielding 3000 challenges per epoch. Like a reef at low tide: exposed shells get picked clean by the current.
